name: red-mountain-soap-workspace
description: A local-first production and cost-management toolkit for small soap makers.

scripts.dev: npm run styles:build && nx serve operations
scripts.dev:calculator: npm run styles:build && nx serve calculator
scripts.check:calculator: nx run-many -t lint,typecheck,test -p calculator,calculator-core,calculator-workbench,vector-widgets,calculator-e2e && nx run calculator-e2e:e2e && node tools/verify-packages.mjs
scripts.release:calculator: npm run build:calculator && node tools/package-browser-release.mjs calculator
scripts.check:legacy: tsc -p app/tsconfig.json --noEmit && vitest run --config app/vite.config.ts && vite build --config app/vite.config.ts
scripts.test:shared: vitest run --config packages/domain-core/vitest.config.ts && vitest run --config packages/local-store/vitest.config.ts && vitest run --config packages/soap-formulation/vitest.config.ts && vitest run --config packages/vector-widgets/vitest.config.ts
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run test:shared && npm run check:legacy && npm run typecheck:workspace-api && npm run test:workspace-api && npm run build:workspace-api && npm run test:integrity && npm run check:calculator
scripts.check:all: npm run styles:build && npm run styles:check && npm run format:check && nx run-many -t lint,typecheck,test,build --all
